flags: Route scope: 64.4 miles refers to the state byway; the 76.7-mile National Forest loop includes US 64, while the National Scenic Byway covers only 17.6 miles of US 276. NCDOT uses the national label broadly; the text preserves the narrower designation scope.
Driving order follows material from Rosman toward Balsam Grove and Woodrow, then south toward Brevard, reversing the current draft and NCDOT description.

Biltmore school sources distinguish informal teaching in 1896 from the 1898 catalog/opening; the moment omits a founding date. The cache also contains an internally inconsistent account of a 1950 reunion and a memorial dated after Schenck’s 1955 death; not used.

Vehicle restrictions checked against the saved 2021 NCDOT guide only, not a live road-status service. Sliding Rock staffing and access were not independently verified with its operator; no fee, hours or guaranteed swimming access is published.
No current claims were dropped for lack of cache support. Kayaking injury, pool depth and temperature were omitted as unnecessary to these stories.

NCDOT PDF extraction interleaves columns. Some verbatim evidence necessarily includes unrelated intervening text; the waterfall height and roadside position are independently corroborated by cache/25.txt.
